name: Medusamon
main_effect:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Progress＞ (While attacking, your opponent's effects don't affect this Digimon.)
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon. Then, by returning 2 cards from their trash to the bottom of the deck, they play 2 [Petrification] Tokens. (Digimon/White/3000 DP/[Your Turn] This Digimon can't suspend. [On Deletion] Trash your top security card.) After, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for each of your opponent's Digimon until their turn ends.
